content:
Full-Service Facility Management Across the UAE

Certified. Reliable. Efficient. Three words that best describe us!

Discover integrated facility services designed for commercial and residential properties throughout all seven emirates of the UAE, especially valued by businesses and homeowners in Dubai.

Book a Consultation

Trusted by businesses and homes across the UAE

From Dubai’s skyline to Abu Dhabi’s high-end villas, Sharjah’s industrial zones to Fujairah’s resorts, we are the preferred partner for efficient, safe, and sustainable facilities management. 
Whether you require management for a corporate office, hotel, residential community, villa, warehouse, or commercial complex, we provide the most dependable and customised FM solutions in the UAE. Our comprehensive approach ensures that properties of all sizes remain safe, functional, and compliant year-round. As a full-service provider, we support clients requiring either single-service solutions or fully integrated facility management contracts. From planned preventive maintenance (PPM) to reactive 24/7 support, our sole mission is to ensure seamless operational performance across all sectors and locations.

Talk to our team

Is this what you’re looking for?

Why we are the best Facility Management Partner?

Nationwide coverage with regional teams in each emirate

Green cleaning and energy-efficient solutions

Transparent pricing and customisable AMC options

Talk to our team

Certified, sustainable & locally trusted

We proudly serve clients across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and other emirates. With deep knowledge of local compliance, multilingual teams, and a commitment to sustainability, we’ve earned our reputation as the go-to FM company for both residential and commercial clients.

Looking for peace of mind year-round?

Go for Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)

Our Annual Maintenance Contracts offer cost-effective, planned preventive and corrective services that keep your property in best condition. Whether you own a villa, office building, or retail outlet, our AMC plans reduce downtime, extend asset lifespan, and improve operational efficiency.

Learn more about AMC packages

About us

We are a proudly UAE-based facility management company, founded on the principles of transparency, efficiency, and local expertise. With years of hands-on experience, we understand the unique climate and infrastructure challenges across the Emirates. Our bilingual staff, ISO standards, and strong client relationships make us more than a service provider—we’re your operational partner.

Learn more

Frequently Asked Questions

Still have questions? Our team is here to help 24/7.

Talk to Our Experts

How much does facility management or an AMC cost in the UAE?

Pricing depends on property type and scope; a villa AMC typically starts in the low thousands of dirhams per year, while commercial and mixed-use properties are quoted after a site survey.

Do you subcontract work, or does Connect FM do it directly?

Connect FM self-delivers core services with our own certified technicians, so there’s one point of accountability, not a subcontractor chain where it’s unclear who’s liable if something goes wrong.

What's actually included in an Annual Maintenance Contract?

Connect FM’s AMCs cover HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and fire safety systems, with scheduled preventive visits plus priority emergency support. The exact scope is written into your contract upfront, no surprise exclusions later.

How fast do you respond to an emergency call-out?

Our 24/7 emergency team responds across Dubai and the wider UAE, with priority response built into every AMC. For non-emergency requests, we typically schedule a site visit within 24–48 hours.

Still have questions? Our team is here to help 24/7.

We are a proudly UAE-based facility management company.

Connect FM is a leading facility management and integrated services provider in the UAE.

Dubai's Most Trusted AC Duct Cleaning Service

Fast, certified, and trusted by thousands of villa and apartment owners.

Book now

Signs your home needs a Duct Clean

  • Some rooms feel warmer than others
  • Electricity bills going up without explanation

Full duct and vent cleaning

title: Cleaning & Housekeeping
content:
1. Home

Cleaning and Housekeeping Services in Dubai & UAE

In Dubai’s climate, dust, sand, and humidity build up quickly — creating not just an untidy appearance but potential health risks.
Our certified team uses professional tools and eco-friendly products to clean every corner, top to bottom, making your space look like new.
Why rely on untrained staff with the wrong tools when you can hire experts at a lower cost?
From house cleaning to deep cleaning and specialised solutions, we deliver professional cleaning services across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and the wider UAE.

Book a Consultation

Why Professional Cleaning and Housekeeping matters

A clean environment is more than just looks, it’s about health, hygiene, and peace of mind.

Why Deep Cleaning is essential?

The UAE’s climate — with sand, humidity, and closed environments — makes deep cleaning more than just a luxury. Over time, hidden dust, grease, and bacteria build up in kitchens, bathrooms, furniture, and air vents. Left untreated, this can lead to bad odours, allergens, mould, and even health risks.

Our Deep Cleaning services

House deep cleaning

Top-to-bottom cleaning for villas and apartments.

Ideal for move-in/move-out or seasonal resets.

Grease removal and sanitisation.

Fresh, odour-free furniture.

Office deep cleaning

Hygienic workstations, lobbies, and restrooms.

Request a deep cleaning inspection

Residential Deep Cleaning

A clean home is vital for family comfort and health. But have you noticed your kids or family members getting sick more often? One common reason is hidden dust, bacteria, and allergens that regular cleaning doesn’t remove.
That’s why our home deep cleaning services go beyond tidying up. Using eco-friendly products and specialised liquids, we help eliminate bacteria, mould, and allergens — making your home not just tidy, but truly healthy and safe for your loved ones.

Our services are tailored for:

Villas and apartments that need a full refresh.

Kitchens and bathrooms that require thorough sanitisation.

Families seeking a healthier environment free of dust and allergens.

Landlords and tenants needing move-in/move-out deep cleans.

Commercial Deep Cleaning

Businesses need spotless spaces to maintain professionalism and staff wellbeing. We provide deep cleaning for offices, hotels, and retail properties, including:

Regular deep cleaning for high-traffic areas.

Sanitisation of workstations, reception areas, and meeting rooms.

Restaurant and kitchen deep cleaning.

Large-scale cleaning for facility managers and landlords.

5 Signs you may need Deep Cleaning

If you notice these, it’s time to call our deep cleaning company.

Bad odours that don’t go away after routine cleaning.

Dust and allergens triggering allergies or asthma.

Grease, stains, or mold in kitchens and bathrooms.

Furniture that looks dull, stained, or smells musty.

A home or office that doesn’t feel “fresh” even after cleaning.

Emergency & Same Day Deep Cleaning in Dubai

Hosting an event? Moving into a new property tomorrow? Some jobs can’t wait. Our team provides same-day deep cleaning services across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and the Northern Emirates. From a last-minute deep clean apartment service to emergency commercial cleaning, we respond fast.

Contact our cleaning team

Certified cleaners with advanced training.

Residential and commercial deep cleaning expertise.

Eco-friendly, family- and pet-safe products.

Flexible one-time or scheduled plans.

Trusted by families and businesses across the UAE.

Transparent pricing with no hidden costs.

What is the difference between regular cleaning and deep cleaning?

Regular cleaning maintains surface-level hygiene, while deep cleaning targets built-up dirt, bacteria, and hard-to-reach areas.

Pricing depends on property size and condition, but we provide customized quotes based on inspection or details shared.

A deep clean can take several hours to a full day, depending on the size and level of cleaning required.

Most properties benefit from deep cleaning every 3 to 6 months, especially in high-use environments.

We use professional-grade equipment and approved cleaning agents, designed for thorough and safe results.

In most cases, you can stay, but temporary absence may be recommended for intensive treatments.

title: Grease Trap Cleaning

1. Home

Grease Trap Cleaning in Dubai & UAE

One blocked grease trap in Dubai can mean a DM fine, a week of operational disruption — or a 90-minute service call.

Running a restaurant, hotel, or commercial kitchen in the UAE? Then you know a blocked or neglected grease trap isn’t just a nuisance – it’s a compliance risk. Foul odours, clogged drains, and surprise inspections can shut down operations and cost thousands in fines.
Our certified grease trap cleaning services keep your business safe, compliant, and efficient across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and the wider UAE.

Book a Consultation

Why Grease Trap Cleaning is essential?

Every commercial kitchen in the UAE produces fats, oils, and grease (FOG) as a byproduct of cooking. Without a functioning grease trap, this FOG flows directly into Dubai’s municipal drainage network — which is why Dubai Municipality makes grease trap installation and regular cleaning a legal requirement for all food establishments, not a recommended practice.

The problem is not just regulatory. Inside an uncleaned grease trap, FOG solidifies over time. Combined with food solids and wastewater, it forms a hardened blockage that restricts drainage flow, creates anaerobic bacterial activity, and generates hydrogen sulphide gas — the source of the rotten-egg odour that signals a trap well overdue for service. 

In a restaurant kitchen, that smell reaches dining areas. In a hotel, it reaches corridors and guest rooms. In a food court, it affects adjacent units that had nothing to do with the original neglect.

Regulatory compliance you can rely on

Dubai Municipality’s Grease Trap Guideline (2021) makes regular grease trap cleaning and proper waste disposal mandatory for food establishments. Businesses must:

Clean grease traps on schedule and keep service records

Use only licensed companies to transport and dispose of waste

Ensure traps are correctly sized, installed, and maintained

Non-compliance can result in fines starting from AED 5,000 up to AED 100,000 under Local Order No. 8 of 2002  with repeat violations doubling penalties.
We help you stay compliant by providing cleaning certificates, maintaining logs, and disposing of waste through municipality-approved facilities using licensed transport.

Our Grease Trap Cleaning services

We provide tailored solutions for businesses of every size:

Grease trap cleaning

Safe and thorough removal of fats, oils, and solids.

Grease trap clean out & clean up

Deep service for heavily blocked units.

Fat trap cleaning & grease arrestor cleaning

Keeping systems compliant and odour-free.

For high-capacity units in hotels, malls, and central kitchens.

Scheduled maintenance

Routine plans that reduce costs and prevent emergencies.

Yes, regular grease trap cleaning is required for commercial kitchens to meet municipality regulations.

Cleaning frequency depends on usage, but most kitchens require servicing every 1 to 3 months.

What are the signs that a grease trap needs urgent cleaning?

Slow drainage, foul odors, and grease overflow are clear indicators that immediate cleaning is needed.

It includes grease removal, sludge extraction, and safe disposal, followed by system inspection.

Yes, improper disposal can lead to penalties, so compliance with regulations is critical.

title: Water Tank Cleaning
content:
1. Home

Water Tank Cleaning Services in Dubai & UAE

In Dubai, your water passes through a storage tank before it reaches your tap. When was that tank last cleaned?

Safe water starts with a clean tank. Our certified team delivers professional water tank cleaning services across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and the wider UAE,  keeping your water supply hygienic and compliant with UAE health standards.

Book a Consultation

Why Water Tank Cleaning is essential?

In the UAE, where most water is stored in tanks before use, neglecting cleaning can cause sediment, bacteria, and algae buildup. This doesn’t just affect water taste and odour — it can also pose serious health risks, including stomach infections, skin problems, and bacterial contamination.
Did you know one of the most common complaints from people moving to Dubai is hair loss? Poor water quality is one of the contributing factors. Regular water tank cleaning helps reduce exposure to impurities in the water supply, acting as a preventive measure to protect both your health and your hair.
That’s why cleansing water tanks at least twice a year is required by UAE health regulations (and for hospitals, schools, and restaurants, every three months). Our technicians ensure safe, hygienic, and reliable water supplies for households and businesses.

Our Water Tank Cleaning services

We provide a complete range of tank cleaning services:

Manual and mechanical tank cleaning - thorough removal of dirt and buildup.

Eco-friendly disinfecting -  approved treatments safe for drinking water.

Water tank cleaning services for all types - plastic, GRP, concrete, and underground tanks.

Routine maintenance and emergency tank cleaning — available 24/7.

Request a tank inspection

Residential Water Tank Cleaning

Families rely on clean water every day, for drinking, cooking, and bathing. Our residential tank cleaning services ensure:

Safe, hygienic water for households.

Removal of bad odours, algae, and sediment.

Compliance with Dubai Municipality guidelines.

Peace of mind knowing your family’s water is safe.

Commercial Water Tank Cleaning

Hotels, offices, and residential communities require reliable, clean water systems. We deliver large-scale commercial tank cleaning services, including:

Scheduled water tank cleaning for high-demand properties.

Disinfecting centralised water storage systems.

Preventive cleaning to reduce complaints and risks.

Full compliance with UAE water hygiene standards.

Emergency Water Tank Cleaning

A contaminated water supply can’t wait. Our 24/7 emergency tank cleaning services are available across all Emirates. Whether it’s algae growth, foul odours, or urgent disinfection, we respond quickly to restore water quality.

Contact our cleaning team

5 signs you need Water Tank Cleaning

Are you a new homeowner in Dubai — or recently moved to the UAE? Many people don’t realise how quickly water tanks here can become contaminated.

To help, we’ve listed the five most common signs it’s time to call us for professional water tank cleaning:

Foul odours or bad taste in your water

Visible algae, sediment, or debris inside the tank

Cloudy water coming from taps

Unexplained stomach or skin irritations

A DEWA or municipality notice requiring tank cleaning

Why choose us for Water Tank Cleaning?

Certified water tank cleaners across the UAE.

Approved eco-friendly disinfectants for safe water.

Residential and commercial expertise.

Emergency services available 24/7.

Transparent pricing with no hidden charges.

Trusted by households, businesses, and facility managers.

Discover AMC Packages

Frequently Asked Questions

Still have questions? Our team is here to help 24/7.

Talk to Our Experts

Is water tank cleaning mandatory in Dubai?

Yes, regular cleaning is required to maintain water safety and comply with regulations.

What happens if I don't clean my water tank on schedule?

Contaminants can build up, affecting water quality and potentially causing health risks.

What does a professional water tank clean involve?

It includes draining, scrubbing, disinfecting, and refilling the tank under controlled conditions.

Does the water need to be turned off during cleaning?

Yes, water supply is temporarily stopped to allow proper cleaning and disinfection.

Can anyone clean a water tank, or does the company need to be DM-certified?

Only certified companies should perform the service to ensure compliance and safety.

How much does water tank cleaning cost in Dubai?

Costs vary based on tank size and accessibility, but quotes are provided upfront.

How do I know if my water tank is contaminated?

Unusual taste, odor, or discoloration are common signs of contamination.

Still have questions? Our team is here to help 24/7.

Does fleet management only apply to trucks and delivery vehicles, or other assets too?

GPS fleet tracking reduces costs by showing you the fastest route to a location. It also stops or minimizes bad driving habits such as excessive idling or speeding, which significantly reduces fuel expenses. You can also track vehicle health to stop expensive, unexpected breakdowns so your drivers can work more efficiently.

Our fleet management systems are quick to deploy and integrate into your existing operations.

Our systems give out real-time alerts if a vehicle or piece of equipment leaves its designated area. You immediately get notified of any unauthorized movement.

Our fleet management helps you with UAE regulatory compliance as we adhere to the local transport and safety regulations.

title: AC Cleaning
content:
1. Home

AC and Duct Cleaning Services Across the UAE

Breathe healthier air with professional AC duct cleaning across Dubai. Dust and mold inside ducts not only affect health but also reduce airflow and strain your system. Our certified technicians ensure cleaner air and efficient cooling for your home or business.

Book a Consultation

Why AC Duct Cleaning is essential in the UAE?

Air conditioning systems in the UAE work harder than almost anywhere else in the world. Over time, dust, sand, bacteria, and mold build up inside ducts and vents, reducing efficiency and affecting indoor air quality.

Regular AC duct cleaning helps to:

Improve airflow and cooling efficiency

Reduce allergens, mould, and bacteria in your home or office

Lower electricity bills by improving system performance

Prevent bad odours caused by dirty ducts and filters

Extend the life of your AC system

Looking for ac duct cleaning near me? Our local teams provide quick, professional service across all seven emirates.

Our comprehensive AC Cleaning service

We provide a full range of AC and duct cleaning services designed to improve air quality, enhance cooling efficiency, and extend the life of your system:

Duct and vent cleaning

Clears dust, sand, and debris for healthier airflow throughout your property.

Deep AC cleaning

Includes coils, condensers, and internal components to maximise performance.

Filter cleaning and replacement

Stops blockages, reduces allergens, and supports cleaner indoor air.

Commercial ductwork cleaning

Specialised solutions for offices, hotels, and large facilities that demand high-performance cooling.

Our certified technicians use advanced equipment and eco-friendly sanitising agents to deliver cleaner air and safer environments for families, employees, and guests. From family villas and busy offices to large hotel complexes, we tailor our air conditioning cleaning service to meet your exact needs.

Residential & commercial AC Duct Cleaning

Searching for air duct cleaning companies near me? We are one of the most trusted providers in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and beyond. We provide AC and duct cleaning solutions for both homeowners and businesses:

Residential AC Cleaning

Villas, apartments, and community residences. Cleaner air reduces allergies and improves family comfort.

Commercial AC Cleaning

Offices, hotels, retail spaces, schools, and warehouses. A cleaner system means healthier air for employees and guests, and improved operational efficiency.

Air vent cleaning & indoor air quality

Over time, dust, sand, and bacteria build up inside AC vents. This doesn’t just reduce cooling efficiency, it also affects the air you breathe every day. Poorly maintained vents can spread allergens, mold spores, and fine particles throughout your home or workplace, contributing to respiratory irritation, sickness and reduced comfort.

That’s why regular air vent cleaning is essential. By keeping ducts and vents clear, you ensure:

Consistent airflow and balanced cooling across all rooms

A healthier indoor environment with fewer allergens

Improved energy efficiency and lower electricity bills

For larger properties, we also provide AC ventilation cleaning to maintain clean, reliable airflow in hotels, offices, and industrial systems.

Speak with an expert

Transparent & affordable AC duct cleaning prices

We believe in clear, honest pricing. The cost of AC duct cleaning can vary depending on your property size, system type, and the level of cleaning required, but we always provide a detailed quote before any work begins. Our services are competitively priced, with no hidden charges — giving homeowners and businesses peace of mind when budgeting for air conditioning cleaning.

Request a free site survey and quote

Why choose our AC Cleaning company?

Certified air conditioning cleaning company in the UAE

Specialists in ac duct and vent cleaning for residential and commercial systems

Advanced cleaning tools and eco-friendly sanitisation products

Coverage across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and all seven emirates

From quick air conditioning cleaning services for homes to full-scale air duct cleaning for hotels, offices, and industrial sites, we deliver professional results across the UAE.

How often should AC ducts be cleaned in the UAE?

You should clean your AC ducts every 6 to 12 months. Heavy use of AC requires more frequent cleaning.

What is the difference between AC cleaning and AC maintenance?

Cleaning removes dirt from ducts whereas AC maintenance checks for system health.

Can dirty AC ducts make people sick?

Yes, dirty AC ducts can affect health as they spread dust and allergens.

The total cost of AC duct cleaning in Dubai depends on the system size. We give a clear quote so ConnectFM’s clients always know how much the AC duct cleaning will cost them.

Will duct cleaning improve my AC's cooling performance?

Duct cleaning improves your AC’s cooling performance. Clean ducts mean unrestricted airflow which results in better cooling.

What equipment do you use for duct cleaning?

We use vacuum and brushing tools for duct cleaning, and we use safe cleaning machines.

Can you clean AC systems in occupied buildings without disruption?

Yes, we work with minimal disruption, and we clean occupied spaces.

No cooling or weak airflow

Unusual noises or vibrations

Motor or fan issues that require immediate attention

Water leakage

Drainage blockages or faulty piping

Frequent cycling on/off

Thermostat or electrical malfunctions

Bad odours or poor air quality

Ductwork and coil issues

Negative impressions for guests and clients.

Repeated infestations that become harder to manage.

Sealing entry points and providing eco-friendly barriers.

Request an ant inspection

1. Home

Bed Bug Control Services
in Dubai & UAE

Few pests cause as much stress as bed bugs. These tiny insects hide in mattresses, sofas, and furniture, biting at night and leaving itchy welts. Worse still, they spread quickly through apartments, hotels, and staff accommodations. Our certified team provides safe and effective bed bug treatment across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and the wider UAE.

Book a Consultation

Why Bed Bug Control is essential?

Unlike other pests, bed bugs don’t just stay in one place, they hitchhike through luggage, clothes, and furniture, spreading from room to room or even from neighbours’ apartments. Once established, they’re nearly impossible to remove with DIY sprays.

Professional bed bug pest control is essential because:

They reproduce rapidly and spread fast.

Bites cause irritation, loss of sleep, and stress.

Hotels, apartments, and villas risk reputational damage.

DIY methods often scatter them instead of eliminating them.

Our treatments target all stages of the bed bug life cycle, from eggs to adults, ensuring long-lasting results.

Our Bed Bug treatment services

We provide discreet, professional bed bug treatments tailored to both homes and businesses:

Bed bug inspection & detection

finding hidden hotspots in mattresses, sofas, and furniture.

Targeted bed bug pest control

safe treatments that kill bugs at every stage.

Bed bugs removal & follow-up treatments

ensuring infestations are fully eliminated.

Preventive solutions

blocking re-infestations from neighbouring units or repeated sources.

 Request a bed bug inspection today

Residential Bed Bug Pest Control

No one should lose sleep over bed bugs. Even if you keep your home spotless, bed bugs can arrive from neighbours, luggage, or deliveries. That’s why our residential bed bug treatments are designed to restore peace of mind and comfort in your home.

We provide:

Bed bug pest control for villas and apartments.

Eco-friendly treatments safe for children and pets.

Thorough cleaning and treatment of mattresses, sofas, and furniture.

Preventive advice to keep infestations from returning.

Commercial Bed Bug Treatments

Hotels, serviced apartments, and staff housing are at high risk of bed bug infestations — and a single complaint can harm your reputation. Our commercial bed bug pest control services are trusted across the UAE for:

Discreet inspections and rapid treatments.

Large-scale management for hotels and residential communities.

Preventive maintenance plans to protect guest comfort.

title: Cockroach Control
content:
1. Home

Cockroach Control Services in Dubai & UAE

Few things are as unsettling as spotting a cockroach in your kitchen, bedroom, or office. These pests are not only unpleasant — they spread bacteria, trigger allergies, and contaminate food. Our certified cockroach exterminators provide fast, effective, and discreet treatments across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and the wider UAE.

Book a Consultation

Why Cockroach Control is essential?

Cockroaches are among the most resilient pests in the UAE. They thrive in warm, humid environments, hiding in drains, kitchens, and storage areas. Once they settle in, they multiply quickly and spread bacteria like salmonella and E. coli — causing health problems and damaging your property’s reputation.
DIY sprays only treat what you can see, leaving the colony untouched. That’s why professional cockroach pest control is essential. Our treatments target nests, breeding areas, and hidden hotspots, eliminating the problem at the source and preventing future infestations.

Our Cockroach Control services

We provide a full range of roach extermination services for homes and businesses:

Cockroach exterminator treatments

Safe, effective, and approved by UAE authorities.

Roach pest control

Targeting visible infestations and hidden nests.

Kitchen & food storage protection

Specialised treatments for restaurants, hotels, and catering businesses.

Preventive cockroach control

Regular inspections and treatments to stop re-infestations.

Request an inspection today

Residential Cockroach Pest Control

Your home should be safe, clean, and pest-free. But cockroaches often enter through drains, pipes, and cracks, spreading across kitchens, bathrooms, and even bedrooms. And even if you keep your apartment spotless, these pests can still arrive from neighbouring flats or even through deliveries.
Our residential cockroach control services don’t just remove visible pests — we block entry points and stop infestations from spreading into your home. We provide discreet, eco-friendly treatments for:

Villas and apartments with recurring infestations.

Kitchens, bathrooms, and drains where roaches thrive.

Families seeking child- and pet-safe extermination methods.

Landlords and tenants requiring move-in/move-out pest clearance.

Commercial Cockroach Extermination

For restaurants, hotels, retail outlets, and offices, cockroaches can ruin reputations and lead to health code violations. That’s why our commercial cockroach pest control services are trusted across the UAE.

We offer:

Routine pest inspections and treatments for food businesses.

24/7 emergency roach exterminator response.

Preventive pest management contracts for hotels, restaurants, and commercial kitchens.

Large-scale pest management for malls, warehouses, and staff accommodations.

Emergency Cockroach Control

Spot cockroaches during peak hours in your restaurant? Found them in your home before guests arrive? Our emergency cockroach exterminators are available across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and the Northern Emirates for urgent treatments that restore safety and peace of mind.

Speak with an expert

5 Signs you need Professional Roach Control

If you notice these, it’s time to call a professional cockroach exterminator.

Seeing cockroaches during the day (a sign of a large infestation).

Unpleasant, musty odours in kitchens or bathrooms.

Small droppings or egg casings near food storage areas.

Smear marks on walls, floors, or surfaces.

Increased allergy or asthma symptoms among family or staff.

Why choose us for Cockroach Pest Control?

Certified roach exterminators with UAE approval

Safe, eco-friendly treatments suitable for homes and businesses

Residential and commercial expertise

Emergency availability across all emirates

Preventive contracts to stop infestations long-term

Transparent pricing with no hidden costs

Discover AMC Packages

Frequently Asked Questions

Still have questions? Our team is here to help 24/7.

Talk to Our Experts

Why do cockroaches keep coming back after I spray them myself?

Store-bought sprays kill visible cockroaches but do not target hidden nests or eggs. Without eliminating the source, the infestation returns quickly.

How much does cockroach control cost in Dubai?

Pricing depends on the infestation severity, property size, and treatment type. A site assessment helps determine the exact cost.

What treatment method do you use for cockroaches?

Professionals use gel baits, targeted sprays, and residual treatments. These methods eliminate active roaches and disrupt breeding cycles.

What should I do before the cockroach treatment visit?

You should clean surfaces, remove food exposure, and clear access to affected areas. This improves treatment effectiveness and coverage.

How quickly will I see results after cockroach treatment?

You may notice a reduction within a few days, while full control takes one to two weeks. Results improve as the treatment continues to work.

Are cockroach treatments safe for kitchens and food areas?

Yes, treatments are designed to be safe when applied correctly, especially in sensitive areas like kitchens. Professionals use controlled and approved products.

Do you provide cockroach control for restaurants and commercial properties?

Yes, services are available for both residential and commercial spaces. Treatments are tailored to meet hygiene and regulatory standards.

title: Fumigation
content:
1. Home

Fumigation Services in Dubai & UAE

When pests get out of control, sprays and traps aren’t enough. And trust us, nothing is more unsettling than realising your property is crawling with invisible invaders. That’s when professional fumigation services step in. Our certified team delivers safe, effective, and fully compliant pest fumigation solutions across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and the wider UAE.

Book a Consultation

Why Fumigation is essential?

Fumigation is a proven method for eliminating pests at every stage of life — from eggs and larvae to adults. Unlike surface treatments, fumigation penetrates deep into cracks, furniture, and storage areas, ensuring complete eradication of hidden infestations.

In the UAE, fumigation is often required for:

Severe bed bug or cockroach infestations.

Termite problems in wood and structural elements.

Large commercial spaces such as warehouses, hotels, or restaurants.

Export shipments, where fumigation certificates are mandatory.

Our Fumigation services

We provide tailored fumigation services for both residential and commercial clients:

Home fumigation

Tackling bed bugs, cockroaches, and termites in villas and apartments.

Commercial fumigation

Pest clearance for hotels, restaurants, offices, and warehouses.

Industrial fumigation

Compliant treatments for factories, shipping containers, and export goods.

Eco-friendly options

Safe methods designed to protect families, pets, and sensitive environments.

Request a fumigation inspection

Residential Fumigation

Your home should feel safe, but hidden pests can cause sleepless nights, health risks, and constant frustration. Our discreet home fumigation services are designed to remove pests completely, leaving your villa or apartment hygienic, pest-free, and comfortable again.

Commercial & Industrial Fumigation

For businesses, pest infestations aren’t just a nuisance — they can lead to fines, shutdowns, and serious damage to reputation. We provide commercial fumigation services designed for high-demand environments, including:

Hotels and restaurants that must meet strict hygiene standards.

Warehouses, shipping companies, and exporters requiring certified fumigation for international trade.

Offices and retail spaces needing fast, discreet pest clearance.

Fumigation certificates issued for export goods meeting international customs requirements.

Our licensed team ensures compliance with UAE regulations, and for exporters, we issue internationally recognised fumigation certificates that meet the requirements of different countries. With us, your shipments are safe, compliant, and ready for customs clearance worldwide

Emergency Fumigation services

When pests threaten to shut down your home or business, waiting isn’t an option. Our 24/7 fumigation experts are available across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and the Northern Emirates for urgent treatments.

Speak with an expert

Why choose us for Fumigation in the UAE?

Certified fumigation specialists with UAE-approved methods.

Residential, commercial, and industrial expertise.

Fast, discreet, and eco-friendly treatments.

Compliance with Dubai Municipality and UAE regulations.

Trusted by families, landlords, hotels, and exporters.

Transparent pricing with no hidden costs.

Discover AMC Packages

Frequently Asked Questions

Still have questions? Our team is here to help 24/7.

Talk to Our Experts

What is fumigation and when is it necessary?

Fumigation is a deep pest control method that uses gas to eliminate hidden infestations. It is necessary when pests like termites or bed bugs spread beyond surface areas and cannot be controlled with sprays.

Do I need to leave my home during fumigation?

Yes, you must vacate your home during fumigation because the treatment involves sealed spaces and controlled gases. You can return once the area is fully ventilated and declared safe.

What preparation is needed before fumigation?

You should remove food, cover sensitive items, and follow specific instructions provided by the pest control team. Proper preparation ensures effective treatment and reduces any safety risks.

Is fumigation safe for children and pets?

Fumigation is safe when handled by professionals, but children and pets must stay away during the process. Safety is ensured once the space is ventilated and approved for re-entry.

How is fumigation different from a standard spray treatment?

Fumigation penetrates deep into structures and targets hidden pests, while sprays only treat exposed surfaces. It is used for severe infestations where surface treatments are not enough.

How much does fumigation cost in Dubai?

The cost depends on the property size, infestation level, and treatment scope. A professional inspection is usually required to provide an accurate estimate.

How long does fumigation treatment last as protection?

Fumigation eliminates existing pests effectively, but long-term protection depends on follow-up prevention and maintenance. Regular inspections help reduce the risk of reinfestation.

Still have questions? Our team is here to help 24/7.

Fumigation Services in Dubai & UAE

When pests get out of control, sprays and traps aren’t enough. And trust us, nothing is more unsettling than realising your property is crawling with invisible invaders. That’s when professional fumigation services step in. Our certified team delivers safe, effective, and fully compliant pest fumigation solutions across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and the wider UAE.

Book a Consultation

Why Fumigation is essential?

Fumigation is a proven method for eliminating pests at every stage of life — from eggs and larvae to adults. Unlike surface treatments, fumigation penetrates deep into cracks, furniture, and storage areas, ensuring complete eradication of hidden infestations.

In the UAE, fumigation is often required for:

Severe bed bug or cockroach infestations.

Termite problems in wood and structural elements.

Large commercial spaces such as warehouses, hotels, or restaurants.

Export shipments, where fumigation certificates are mandatory.

Our Fumigation services

We provide tailored fumigation services for both residential and commercial clients:

Home fumigation

Tackling bed bugs, cockroaches, and termites in villas and apartments.

Commercial fumigation

Pest clearance for hotels, restaurants, offices, and warehouses.

Industrial fumigation

Compliant treatments for factories, shipping containers, and export goods.

Eco-friendly options

Safe methods designed to protect families, pets, and sensitive environments.

Residential Fumigation

Your home should feel safe, but hidden pests can cause sleepless nights, health risks, and constant frustration. Our discreet home fumigation services are designed to remove pests completely, leaving your villa or apartment hygienic, pest-free, and comfortable again.

Commercial & Industrial Fumigation

For businesses, pest infestations aren’t just a nuisance — they can lead to fines, shutdowns, and serious damage to reputation. We provide commercial fumigation services designed for high-demand environments, including:

Hotels and restaurants that must meet strict hygiene standards.

Warehouses, shipping companies, and exporters requiring certified fumigation for international trade.

Offices and retail spaces needing fast, discreet pest clearance.

Fumigation certificates issued for export goods meeting international customs requirements.

Our licensed team ensures compliance with UAE regulations, and for exporters, we issue internationally recognised fumigation certificates that meet the requirements of different countries. With us, your shipments are safe, compliant, and ready for customs clearance worldwide

Emergency Fumigation services

When pests threaten to shut down your home or business, waiting isn’t an option. Our 24/7 fumigation experts are available across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and the Northern Emirates for urgent treatments.

Speak with an expert

What is fumigation and when is it necessary?

Fumigation is a deep pest control method that uses gas to eliminate hidden infestations. It is necessary when pests like termites or bed bugs spread beyond surface areas and cannot be controlled with sprays.

Do I need to leave my home during fumigation?

Yes, you must vacate your home during fumigation because the treatment involves sealed spaces and controlled gases. You can return once the area is fully ventilated and declared safe.

What preparation is needed before fumigation?

You should remove food, cover sensitive items, and follow specific instructions provided by the pest control team. Proper preparation ensures effective treatment and reduces any safety risks.

Is fumigation safe for children and pets?

Fumigation is safe when handled by professionals, but children and pets must stay away during the process. Safety is ensured once the space is ventilated and approved for re-entry.

How is fumigation different from a standard spray treatment?

Fumigation penetrates deep into structures and targets hidden pests, while sprays only treat exposed surfaces. It is used for severe infestations where surface treatments are not enough.

How much does fumigation cost in Dubai?

The cost depends on the property size, infestation level, and treatment scope. A professional inspection is usually required to provide an accurate estimate.

Fumigation eliminates existing pests effectively, but long-term protection depends on follow-up prevention and maintenance. Regular inspections help reduce the risk of reinfestation.

Rodent & Vermin Control Services in Dubai & UAE

Few things cause more alarm than spotting a rat or mouse in your home, office, or business. Trust us, they don’t look nearly as cute as in cartoons, and when they appear by surprise, a small heart attack is guaranteed. Beyond the shock, rodents spread diseases, contaminate food, and damage property. Our certified rodent exterminators provide safe, discreet, and effective rodent pest control across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and the wider UAE.

Book a Consultation

Why Rodent Control matters?

A rodent infestation isn’t just unpleasant — it’s a serious health and safety risk. Rats and mice can:

Spread diseases through droppings and bites.

Contaminate food and water supplies.

Chew through wires and structures, creating fire hazards.

Cause reputational damage for businesses like hotels, cafes, and warehouses.

DIY traps and poisons rarely solve the root problem. Professional vermin control services target hidden nests, breeding areas, and entry points to ensure long-term protection.

Our Rodent & Vermin Control services

We provide complete pest control for rats, mice, and other vermin, including:

Rodent inspection

Locating nests, droppings, and entry points.

Rodent exterminator treatments

Safe baits, traps, and eco-friendly methods.

Rodent exclusion

Sealing gaps, pipes, and building entry points.

Preventive vermin control

Monitoring and maintenance to stop re-infestation.

Request a rodent inspection

Residential Rodent Control

Rodents in villas or apartments don’t just cause damage — they put your family’s health at risk. Our residential rodent pest control services include:

Safe, discreet treatments tailored for family homes.

Blocking entry points like drains, vents, and cracks.

Eliminating rodent nests from attics, basements, and hidden spaces.

Family- and pet-safe methods.

Commercial Rodent Control

Hotels, restaurants, warehouses, and offices face strict hygiene and safety requirements. Even a single rodent sighting can result in lost clients and regulatory fines.

Our commercial vermin control services provide:

Discreet inspections and treatments outside of business hours.

Rodent control for restaurants, cafes, and food storage facilities.

Ongoing monitoring and preventive maintenance contracts.

DM food safety inspection-ready documentation — service reports provided after every visit.

Call our emergency pest control team

Gnaw marks on wires, furniture, or packaging

Foul odours caused by rodent nests or urine

Food packaging torn or contaminated

Highly experienced and certified rodent exterminators

Common signs include droppings, gnaw marks, scratching noises, and unusual odors. Activity is often noticed at night.

What methods do you use for rodent control?

Professionals use traps, baiting systems, and exclusion techniques. The goal is to eliminate rodents and block entry points.

How quickly can you eliminate a rodent infestation?

Initial results may appear within days, but full control can take longer depending on severity. Consistent monitoring improves outcomes.

title: Termite Control
content:
1. Home

Termite Control services
across the UAE

Termites are called the “silent destroyers” for a reason. By the time you notice damage, these pests may already have eaten through your wood, furniture, or even the structure of your home. Our certified team provides expert anti termite treatment and prevention across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and the wider UAE.

Book a Consultation

Why Termite Control matters?

Unlike other pests, termites don’t make noise or leave obvious signs — until it’s too late. They feed 24/7 on wood, paper, and even wiring insulation, causing thousands of dirhams in structural damage.
That’s why professional termite treatment is essential. DIY sprays don’t reach hidden colonies inside walls or foundations. Our advanced detection methods and anti termite treatments protect your property long-term.

Left untreated, a termite infestation in your home can:

Weaken doors, cupboards, and flooring.

Cause costly repairs to wooden structures.

Lower property value and tenant confidence.

Spread quickly across villas, apartments, and commercial sites.

Our Termite Control services

We provide complete termite control solutions for both residential and commercial clients:

Termite inspection

Detecting activity before visible damage occurs.

Anti termite treatment

Applying proven barriers and soil treatments.

Corrective termite treatment

Eliminating existing infestations in homes and offices.

Preventive maintenance

Scheduled inspections and protective treatments to stop termites returning.

Request a termite inspection

Residential Termite Treatment

Your home is one of your biggest investments — don’t let termites destroy it. Dubai's irrigated villa gardens providing perfect moisture conditions to the foundation, the prevalence of subterranean termites in sandy UAE soil, or the fact that termite damage is typically excluded from property insurance. We provide residential termite protection and removal tailored for villas and apartments:

Safe anti-termite treatments for wood, furniture, and flooring.

Preventive barriers during home construction or renovation.

Corrective treatments for existing infestations.

Eco-friendly and family-safe solutions.

Commercial Termite Control

Hotels, offices, and warehouses are especially vulnerable to termite infestations due to high wooden content, constant cooling, and large structural areas. Our commercial termite control solutions include:

Preventive anti termite treatments during construction.

Corrective treatments for existing colonies.

Regular inspections for property managers and landlords.

Large-scale termite protection for housing developments and commercial towers.

Emergency Termite Treatment

Termite damage spreads fast — every week counts. If you suspect termites, our emergency team provides urgent termite control services across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and the Northern Emirates.

Call our emergency pest control team

5 Signs you may need Termite Treatment

If you notice these, call us for professional termite treatment immediately.

Hollow-sounding wood when tapped

Discarded termite wings near windows or doors

Mud tunnels along walls or foundations

Doors or windows suddenly sticking

Furniture showing unexplained cracks or weakness

Why choose us for Termite Control?

Certified pest technicians with termite expertise.

Residential and commercial anti termite treatments.

Preventive and corrective solutions for long-term protection.

Eco-friendly, safe, and approved methods.

Trusted by homeowners, developers, and property managers across the UAE.

Transparent pricing with no hidden costs.

Discover AMC Packages

Frequently Asked Questions

Still have questions? Our team is here to help 24/7.

Talk to Our Experts

How do I know if I have termites?

Hollow-sounding wood, mud tubes, and discarded wings near windows or doors are signs of having termites. Damage often appears before live termites are seen.

What types of termites are common in Dubai?

Subterranean termites are the most common, and they live underground while feeding on structures. They are known for causing significant damage.

What is the difference between pre-construction and post-construction termite treatment?

Pre-construction treatment protects the structure during building, while post-construction treatment targets existing infestations. Both serve different stages of protection.

How much does termite control cost in Dubai?

Costs depend on property size, infestation level, and treatment type. A professional inspection provides an accurate estimate.

How long does termite treatment last?

Termite treatments can last several years, depending on the method used and environmental factors. Periodic inspections help maintain protection.

Can termites damage a concrete building?

Yes, termites can enter through cracks and attack wooden elements within concrete structures. They do not eat concrete but can bypass it.

Is termite treatment safe for families and pets?

Yes, treatments are safe when applied by professionals using approved methods. Safety guidelines are followed strictly during and after application.

Still have questions? Our team is here to help 24/7.

Drain Cleaning Services in Dubai & UAE

Slow drains or bad smells? Blocked pipes get worse fast — here’s what to do.

Blocked sink or overflowing toilet? It’s time to call the experts.
Our certified plumbers provide professional drain cleaning across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and the other Emirates. From unclogging a kitchen sink to full drain clean-outs in commercial buildings, we deliver fast, reliable solutions you can count on — using modern equipment, camera inspections, and eco-friendly methods to ensure long-lasting results and prevent future plumbing issues.

Book a Consultation

Why professional Drain Cleaning matters?

A clogged drain is more than just an inconvenience. Left untreated, it can cause foul odours, standing water, mould growth, and even flooding. In the UAE, where kitchens and bathrooms are in constant use, grease, soap, food particles, and sand quickly build up, leading to recurring blockages.
DIY fixes often do more harm than good. That’s why professional drain cleaning services are essential. Our plumbers use advanced tools to clear blockages completely, restore smooth water flow, and prevent future problems.

Our Drain Cleaning services

We provide comprehensive services for homes and businesses across the UAE, including:

Request a drain inspection

Sink Drain Cleaning

unclogging blocked sinks caused by grease, food particles, and soap residue.

Kitchen Drainage Solutions

restoring flow in heavily used kitchen pipelines.

Toilet Drainage & Unblocking

solving slow flushes and completely blocked toilets.

Drain Clean-Outs

full pipeline clearing to remove deep, stubborn clogs.

Emergency Unclogging Services

available 24/7 for urgent blockages.

Request a drain inspection

Residential Drain Cleaning

Blocked sinks and toilets can quickly disrupt your home. From sink drain plumbing to toilet drainage, our plumbers provide quick, reliable solutions that restore hygiene and convenience.
Whether it’s a slow-draining kitchen sink or the need to clean a sink drain completely, we make sure your home stays functional and comfortable.

Commercial buildings

Hotels, restaurants, malls, and offices can’t afford downtime caused by drainage issues. A single blocked pipeline in a kitchen or restroom can affect operations, customer satisfaction, and even health standards.

Our commercial drain cleaning services cover:

Kitchen drainage for restaurants and hotels

Toilet and restroom drainage solutions for commercial properties

Large-scale drain clearing services for malls and offices

Preventive maintenance to stop recurring issues

Emergency Drain Unblocking

Sometimes a blocked drain can’t wait until tomorrow. That’s why we offer 24/7 emergency drain unblocking across Dubai and other Emirates. Whether it’s water backing up in your kitchen or a completely blocked toilet, our team responds quickly to provide lasting solutions.

Speak with an expert

5 Signs You Need Professional Drain Cleaning

If you notice any of these, it’s time to book professional unclogging services before the problem gets worse.

Water draining slowly from sinks, showers, or toilets

Gurgling sounds from your pipes

Persistent bad odours from drains

Water backing up into sinks or toilets

Frequent recurring clogs

Certified plumbers with years of UAE experience

Advanced tools for long-lasting results

What causes drains to block so frequently in Dubai?

Grease and sand cause frequent blockages, and poor disposal habits also add to the issue.

We use jetting and mechanical tools, and we clear both minor and major clogs.

Can you clean commercial kitchen drains and grease traps?

Yes, we clean kitchen drains and grease traps, and we handle commercial systems.

We inspect the pipe condition, and we recommend repair or replacement.

No, slow drains can have other causes than a blockage, and buildup can reduce flow.

How often should drains be professionally cleaned?

Drains should be professionally cleaned once or twice a year, but high usage needs more frequent cleaning.

title: Leak Detection
content:
1. Home

Water Leak Detection Services in Dubai & UAE

DEWA bill suddenly higher than usual? It could be a hidden leak.

Undetected leaks cause damage and drive up costs. Our certified technicians provide fast, accurate water leak detection across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and the wider UAE — finding and fixing problems before they escalate.

Once we detect the leak, our plumbing repair team handles the fix on the same visit.

Book a Consultation

Why water Leak Detection matters?

Most water leaks stay hidden until they’ve already caused serious problems. A small drip inside a wall or under a floor can turn into structural damage, mold growth, and skyrocketing DEWA bills. Left untreated, even a minor leakage in a pipe can become an expensive repair.
That’s why early, professional water leak detection is so important. Our specialists use advanced, non-invasive tools to detect a leak quickly and accurately — without drilling or unnecessary damage to your property.

Our Water Leak Detection services

We provide comprehensive services for homes and businesses across the UAE, including:

Book a leak detection survey

Hidden leak detection

Locating leaks in walls, floors, and underground pipelines.

Leaking pipe repair

Identifying and fixing faulty joints, fittings, and broken pipes.

Thermal imaging & acoustic detection

Advanced tools that pinpoint leaks without damage.

Water consumption monitoring

Helping to spot abnormal usage before it escalates.

Preventive
inspections

routine leak detection to stop future damage.

Residential Leak Detection

Homeowners often struggle with leakage in pipes that are out of sight — behind walls, under floors, or inside ceilings. Signs such as damp patches, mould, low water pressure, or high utility bills often point to a hidden problem.
Our team uses advanced tools to locate the exact source, saving time, money, and property damage.

Commercial buildings

For hotels, offices, shopping malls, and industrial sites, undetected leaks can cause major disruption and financial loss. From water detection leaks in water system to leaking underground pipelines, we provide fast, reliable solutions for large-scale properties.
We work closely with facility managers to deliver proactive leak detection and timely repairs that minimise downtime.

Emergency Leak Detection & Repairs

A sudden leaking pipe can’t wait. That’s why we provide 24/7 emergency services across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and all seven emirates. Our mobile teams respond quickly to detect a leak and perform urgent repairs on-site.

Speak with an expert

Signs you may have a hidden water leak

If you notice any of these, it’s time to book professional leak detection before the problem escalates.

Not all leaks are obvious. Watch for these warning signs:

Unexplained increases in your water bill

Damp patches on walls, ceilings, or floors

Reduced water pressure

Mould or musty odours

Constant sound of running water when taps are off

If you notice any of these, it’s time to book professional leak detection before the problem escalates.

Why choose us for Leak Detection in the UAE?

Certified leak detection specialists with advanced equipment

Non-invasive methods to detect leaks accurately

24/7 emergency response across all emirates

Trusted by homeowners, hotels, offices, and industries

Transparent pricing with no hidden costs

Preventive inspection and AMC options

Discover AMC Packages

Frequently Asked Questions

Still have questions? Our team is here to help 24/7.

Talk to Our Experts

How do I know if I have a hidden water leak in my home?

You can find out if you have a hidden water leak in your house by checking out for damp spots. Smelling mold or getting a high water bill are also signs of a leakage.

What technology do you use to detect hidden leaks?

We use thermal cameras and acoustic tools to quickly find hidden leaks.

Can a hidden leak really increase my DEWA bill that much?

Hidden leaks can significantly increase your DEWA bill.

Do you repair the leak once you find it, or just locate it?

We always provide a complete solution, so we not only locate but also repair the leak once we have found it.

How long does a leak detection survey take?

The time it takes for a leak detection survey depends on property size. Although, it might usually take a few hours.

Is water leak detection covered by home insurance in the UAE?

Coverage depends on your policy, so you should check with your insurer.

Do you detect leaks in swimming pools and irrigation systems too?

Yes, we detect leaks in pools and irrigation systems, and we cover indoor and outdoor areas.

Still have questions? Our team is here to help 24/7.

We don’t mean to brag, but our carpentry team is among the best in the UAE, craftsmen who treat every project as art. From repairing furniture to custom joinery, we deliver precise, lasting work with a focus on quality.

Book a Consultation

Why quality Carpentry matters?

You know the difference between good and bad carpentry the moment you use it. A door that closes smoothly, a cupboard that slides quietly, a shelf that feels solid, these small details make a big difference in daily life.
That’s why the right carpentry services matter. Poor workmanship doesn’t just spoil the look of your space, it causes daily frustrations and costly repairs. Our carpenters focus on quality you can feel every day, combining traditional skill with modern tools to deliver results that last.

Our Carpentry

Residential Carpentry Services

Large-scale joinery projects for communities and commercial complexes

Our local teams are always on hand to handle urgent carpentry repairs, ensuring your property stays safe, functional, and welcoming.

Call our emergency carpentry team

Experienced and certified carpenters

title: Handyman Services
content:
1. Home

Handyman Services in Dubai & UAE

Tired of low-quality handyman jobs that never last? Our certified team gets it right the first time, delivering reliable, professional handyman services for homes, offices, hotels, and communities across the UAE.

Book a Consultation

Why Handyman Services Matter

Every property, no matter the size, needs regular upkeep. A squeaky door, leaking tap, or broken shelf may seem minor, but left unattended, small problems often grow into expensive repairs.

That’s why having a trusted handyman is so important. Instead of spending your weekends juggling DIY fixes, you can rely on our experienced team to get the job done quickly, safely, and at a fair price.

With us, you’re not just hiring a handyman, you’re getting peace of mind that the job will be done right the first time.

Our Handyman
services

We provide a complete range of general handyman services to make property maintenance simple and stress-free. Our services include:

Repairs & Fixes: 

doors, locks, windows, hinges, and handles

Furniture assembly:

flat-pack, custom furniture, and repairs

Wall & fixture installation

shelves, mirrors, TVs, picture frames, and curtain rods

Painting & patchwork:

small touch-ups and surface repairs

Minor plumbing & electrical: 

taps, sockets, switches, and fittings

General home improvements:

caulking, sealing, and preventive upkeep

Whether you need one small job done or a full list of tasks completed, our handyman contractors are ready to help.

Residential Handyman Services

Things break — it happens. A door won’t close properly, a tap starts dripping, or you decide it’s time to move a shelf or hang a new mirror. That’s where our handyman services come in. We take care of all the small but important jobs that keep your villa or apartment running smoothly.

From repairing furniture and installing shelves to fixing leaks and squeaky doors, we’re here to make home maintenance easier. No job is too small, and our skilled handypersons always treat your home with the same care as if it were their own.

Commercial Handyman Solutions

For offices, hotels, retail spaces, and residential communities, even small issues can disrupt operations or inconvenience guests. Our handyman contractors provide ongoing support for businesses that need quick, professional fixes.

We regularly assist property managers with:

Office furniture assembly and repairs

Door, lock, and fixture maintenance in hotels and apartments

Painting and touch-ups for retail spaces

Preventive repairs to avoid downtime

With discreet service and flexible scheduling, we ensure your business continues running smoothly.

Emergency & Urgent Handyman Help

Some issues can’t wait – like a jammed door, broken lock, or urgent fixture repair. That’s why we provide 24/7 handyman services in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and all seven emirates.

Our emergency response team is just a call away, ready to resolve issues quickly and prevent further damage.

Call our emergency handyman team

Preventive Maintenance: Save Time & Money

It’s always cheaper and easier to fix problems early. That’s why we also provide preventive maintenance packages designed to keep your property in top condition year-round.

From regular inspections to minor fixes, our preventive approach saves homeowners and businesses both time and money. It also reduces the risk of unexpected breakdowns.

Why choose our Handyman Services

Certified and experienced handymen

Residential and commercial expertise

24/7 availability for urgent jobs

Transparent, upfront pricing with no hidden charges

Trusted by villas, apartments, offices, hotels, and retail businesses

Backed by our full property maintenance team for complete coverage

 Explore our full maintenance solutions

Frequently Asked Questions

Still have questions? Our team is here to help 24/7.

Talk to Our Experts

What types of jobs can a handyman do in Dubai?

Handymen handle minor repairs, installations, and general maintenance tasks including fixing fixtures, assembling furniture, and basic electrical work.

How much does a handyman cost in Dubai?

The cost for hiring a handyman in Dubai depends on the complexity of the job and the duration it takes to complete the task.

How quickly can you send a handyman to my property in Dubai?

We can dispatch a handyman to your property in Dubai within a few hours. Their availability and your location might be the determining factor in how long it takes them to reach you. At ConnectFM, we also have the same-day service available.

Do handymen bring their own tools and materials, or do I need to supply them?

Our handymen bring their own standard tools, while specific materials may be arranged as needed. We disclose any such requirements well in advance.

What is the difference between a handyman and a specialist tradesperson?

A handyman handles general tasks whereas specialists focus on complex or technical work.

Can I book a handyman for an office or commercial property, not just a home?

Yes, handyman services are available for both residential and commercial spaces. Solutions are adapted to business needs.

Is it safe to let a handyman into my home when I'm not there?

Reputable companies use verified professionals, which ensures safety and accountability. You can schedule access based on your comfort.

Still have questions? Our team is here to help 24/7.

title: Landscaping Services
content:
1. Home
Customer Top Choice 2025

Landscaping Services Across the UAE

From villas in Dubai to hotels in Abu Dhabi and residential communities across Sharjah, our certified landscaping team transforms outdoor spaces into functional, beautiful, and sustainable environments. Whether you need landscape design, garden maintenance services, or full villa landscaping, we create tailored solutions that enhance both lifestyle and property value.

Book a Consultation

Why Professional Landscaping matters?

In the UAE’s desert climate, landscaping isn’t just about aesthetics, it’s about sustainability, comfort, and long-term durability. Without the right planning and maintenance:

Plants and grass wither in high heat.

Poor irrigation leads to wasted water and high DEWA bills.

Sand build-up affects outdoor comfort.

Low-quality design reduces property value.

That’s why choosing experienced landscaping companies is essential. We combine innovative design with practical solutions for villas, gardens, hotels, and commercial properties.

Our Landscaping services

We offer a complete range of landscaping & gardening services across the UAE:

Start your landscaping project

Garden landscaping

Tailored designs for villas, communities, and urban residences.

Desert landscaping

Water-wise solutions using native plants, stones, and modern irrigation.

Urban landscaping

Functional outdoor designs for apartments, commercial towers, and public spaces.

Tropical landscaping

Lush, vibrant garden environments for villas, resorts, and pools.

Swimming pool landscaping

Customised pool surroundings for comfort, safety, and style.

Garden maintenance services

Routine care, pruning, irrigation, and seasonal planting.

Residential Landscaping & Garden Design

Your villa or townhouse deserves an outdoor space that matches your lifestyle. Our home garden design and villa landscape design services include:

Tailored garden design and landscaping for homes and communities.

Smart irrigation systems to save water and reduce DEWA bills.

Regular landscape maintenance for year-round greenery and beauty.

Safe, eco-friendly gardening solutions for families and pets.

Commercial & Urban Landscaping

Hotels, resorts, retail centres, and residential communities rely on attractive, sustainable landscaping to welcome guests and residents. Our landscape contractors provide:

Large-scale landscaping architecture and planning.

Green spaces for commercial and mixed-use developments.

Regular landscape maintenance for communities and towers.

Poolside and outdoor leisure landscaping for hospitality businesses.

Emergency garden & landscaping services

Contact our landscaping team

First impressions matter — whether it’s a property viewing, a new tenant moving in, or guests arriving for a special event. In Dubai’s harsh climate, plants can dry out quickly, lawns can lose colour, and an untidy garden can make even the most beautiful villa look neglected. Our 24/7 landscaping team provides:

Fast response for irrigation leaks or sudden plant failures.

Emergency garden refresh and clean-ups.

Quick landscaping and gardening services to ready properties for buyers, tenants, or events.

Contact our landscaping team

Why choose us for Landscaping in the UAE?

Certified and experienced landscaping contractors.

Full-service solutions: design, build, and maintenance.

Expertise in desert landscaping suited to UAE’s climate.

Residential, commercial, and urban landscaping.

Sustainable irrigation and eco-friendly gardening.

Trusted by homeowners, hotels, and property developers.

Transparent pricing and long-term maintenance contracts.

Discover AMC Packages

Frequently Asked Questions

Still have questions? Our team is here to help 24/7.

Talk to Our Experts

How much does landscaping cost for a villa in Dubai?

The cost of landscaping a villa in Dubai depends on the design, materials, and garden size. A consultation can give you a better estimate on the scope and pricing for landscaping your property.

What plants actually survive Dubai's summer heat in a villa garden?

Drought-resistant plants can easily survive Dubai’s summer heat. Palms, bougainvillea, and desert plants thrive in this environment because of their heat tolerance and low water needs.

Is artificial grass worth it in a Dubai villa garden?

Artificial grass is definitely worth it in a Dubai villa garden. Not only does it reduce maintenance and water use, it maintains its green look year-round, making it a very practical choice for many homeowners.

How often does a villa garden need professional maintenance in the UAE?

In the UAE, a villa garden requires weekly or bi-weekly regular maintenance.

What is the difference between softscape and hardscape landscaping?

Softscape landing includes plants and greenery. Whereas hardscape landscaping covers pathways and patios.

Do you install and maintain irrigation systems for villa gardens?

We install and maintain irrigation systems for villa gardens.

Can landscaping increase my villa's property value in Dubai?

Landscaping can increase your villa’s property value in Dubai.

Still have questions? Our team is here to help 24/7.

content:
1. Home

Access Control Systems in Dubai & UAE

Managing who enters your property is as important as protecting what’s inside. Our access control systems give businesses full visibility over staff, visitors, and contractors – ensuring security and compliance. From door access control systems in offices to integrated solutions for hotels, hospitals, and government facilities, we deliver scalable systems tailored to your needs.

With decades of combined expertise, our security engineers have implemented access control technology for sensitive environments worldwide – including international banks, military sites, and government infrastructure. This global experience translates into robust, future-ready solutions you can trust. Whether you require biometric authentication, card readers, remote access, or centralized monitoring, we provide end-to-end deployment, training, and support.

Book a Consultation

Why Access Control matters for businesses?

Keys can be lost, copied, or misused. For companies managing employees, guests, or high-security areas, traditional locks are no longer enough. Modern door access control ensures only authorized people can enter, while giving you detailed records of every movement.

Benefits include:

Increased security for staff, assets, and data

Centralized control for multiple sites or departments

Detailed entry logs for audits and compliance

Flexible options: cards, PIN codes, biometrics, or mobile access

Seamless integration with CCTV and fire safety systems

Our Access Control solutions

We design and install customized access control systems for every scale of business. Our solutions include:

Door access control systems

Secure entry points with card, PIN, or biometric options

Centralized access management

Monitor and manage multiple sites from one dashboard

Visitor & contractor management

Safe, efficient entry for temporary users

Integration with security systems

Combine with CCTV and fire alarms for full protection

Scalable systems

From small offices to enterprise-level multi-site operations

Talk to our experts

Industry-specific Access Control

Every industry has unique requirements. We provide tailored access control systems for:

Corporate offices – secure sensitive areas and manage staff access

Hotels & hospitality – streamline guest access with key cards or mobile entry

Healthcare & hospitals – protect restricted medical areas and patient data

Education – safe entry for schools, universities, and staff facilities

Warehouses & logistics – manage staff and contractor access across multiple sites

Our local teams across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and all seven emirates ensure fast installation and ongoing support.

Annual service & maintenance contracts

Learn more about AMC packages

Access control systems require regular updates and servicing to ensure reliability. We offer Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs) for door access control systems, keeping your security system compliant and running 24/7.

Benefits of an AMC:

Priority support and faster response

Regular system health checks and updates

Reduced downtime and repair costs

Long-term compliance with UAE security standards

Learn more about AMC packages

Certified Access Control provider in the UAE

Choosing the right access control company is about more than hardware — it’s about reliability, compliance, and scalability. We are a certified provider, trusted by property managers, facility operators, and government bodies across the UAE.

Why clients choose us:

Expertise in enterprise-grade access control systems

Integration with wider security systems for a single solution

Transparent pricing and detailed reporting

Fast support and maintenance across the UAE

Trusted by leading businesses, hotels, and institutions

Frequently Asked Questions

Still have questions? Our team is here to help 24/7.

Talk to Our Experts

What types of access control systems do you install?

We design and install customized access control systems for every scale of business. Our solutions include door access control systems, centralized access management, visitor and contract management, integration with security systems, and scalable systems.

Can access control systems track who entered which area and when?

Yes, access control systems can easily track who entered which area and the particular time they entered that area.

What happens during a power outage — do doors lock or unlock?

You can have your access control systems programmed to still work during a power outage by installing failsafe mechanisms, especially for emergency exits.

Can we manage access remotely — add or remove user permissions without being on-site?

Yes, you can remotely manage the access. You can also add or remove user permissions without being on-site.

How does access control integrate with HR systems for employee management?

Access control can integrate with HR systems for employee management for attendance tracking, checking in to the office, and checking out of the office with PIN codes, biometrics, or mobile access.

How many cameras do I actually need for my property?

2 to 6 cameras are more than sufficient for a residential property. Small businesses may benefit from 4 to 8 cameras, medium offices might need 12 cameras, whereas warehouses or industrial facilities might require anywhere between 16 to more than 32 cameras.

For outdoor cameras, you’d want one that can withstand the weather conditions, is more durable, and has specialized features such as night vision and lighting adaptation. Whereas indoor cameras don’t have to be that weatherproof as they are used for monitoring indoors, people, and pets.

Fire Safety Systems in Dubai & UAE

In the UAE, fire safety systems are not optional — they are essential for protecting people, property, and business operations. From fire alarm & fire fighting systems to full building safety solutions, we design, install, and maintain systems that comply with Civil Defense regulations and international standards.

Book a Consultation

Why Fire Safety Systems Matter?

In a city like Dubai, where towers reach high into the sky, fire safety systems are one of the most important parts of every building. Even in the safest environments, accidents can happen — and when they do, early detection and fast response can make all the difference.

A certified fire fighting system is not just about compliance with UAE Civil Defense regulations — it’s about protecting lives, keeping residents safe, and ensuring businesses can operate without disruption.

Our solutions help you:

Detect and respond to fires quickly with reliable alarms

Control risks with sprinklers, extinguishers, and suppression systems

Protect staff, residents, and critical assets

Meet UAE Civil Defense and international safety standards

Reduce downtime and liability in case of emergencies

Our certified team delivers fire safety system installation and maintenance across all seven emirates.

Our Fire Safety solutions

We deliver end-to-end fire fighting and safety systems for residential, commercial, and industrial properties:

Fire alarm systems

Early detection with smart sensors and alarms

Fire fighting systems

Sprinklers, extinguishers, and suppression units

Integrated safety solutions

Combine fire alarms with access control and CCTV

System design & installation

Tailored to UAE building codes and client needs

Maintenance & compliance

Regular inspections to keep your property protected

Talk to our Experts

Industry-specific Fire Safety Systems 

Every property type requires a tailored approach. We provide fire safety system installation for:

Residential communities – villas, apartments, and high-rise towers

Commercial buildings – offices, hotels, retail spaces, and malls

Healthcare & education – hospitals, clinics, schools, and universities

Industrial facilities – warehouses, factories, and oil & gas sites

Whether small or large-scale, we deliver compliant solutions you can rely on.

Annual Fire Safety maintenance contracts

Learn more about AMC packages

Benefits of an AMC:

Regular inspections and preventive servicing

Reduced repair costs and liability risks

Learn more about AMC packages

Certified installers and engineers with UAE expertise

24/7 emergency support and maintenance contracts

Is a fire safety system legally required for my property in the UAE?

Yes, a fire safety system is legally required for your property in the UAE.

Our complete fire safety systems include alarm systems, firefighting systems, integrated safety solutions (fire alarms combined with access control and CCTV), system design, installation, maintenance, and compliance.

How often do fire safety systems need to be serviced?

Fire safety systems need to be regularly inspected and serviced to remain effective. We offer Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs) for fire alarm and fire fighting systems.

We can provide maintenance for your existing and installed fire alarm systems.

The differences between a security guard and officer are their level, responsibility, training, and authority. While guards are more entry-level, security officers are often tasked with overseeing the guards’ security operations, and they get to make independent decisions.

Can security guards make arrests if they catch someone committing a crime?

Moving into a new property or upgrading your current home? Our team makes smart home installation quick, simple, and stress-free across all seven emirates.
