Speak with an installation expert

Why choose us for Smart Home services?

Certified smart home installers with years of UAE experience.

Partnerships with leading home automation companies and brands.

Customised solutions for villas, apartments, and businesses.

Transparent pricing and expert support.

Trusted by homeowners, landlords, and property managers.

Frequently Asked Questions

Still have questions? Our team is here to help 24/7.

Talk to Our Experts

What can actually be controlled in a smart home setup?

With a smart home setup, lighting automation, climate, thermostat, security, access, entertainment systems, and energy can be controlled.

Do smart home systems work with existing appliances, or do I need to replace everything?

You do not need to replace every appliance at your home for smart home systems. Instead, you can have these appliances retrofitted using switches, plugs, and controllers.

What happens to smart home controls during an internet or power outage?

During an internet or power outage, the devices that have sufficient backup or energy source still work. You need to have it planned through a local hub so that your smart home retains control, and your switches, lights, and other automated functions keep running.

Is a smart home system secure from hacking or unauthorized access?

Smart homes aren’t fully secure from hacking or unauthorized access. Still, there are many security measures in place to prevent such incidents from happening.

Can smart home systems be installed in a rented property or apartment?

Efficient waste management is essential for every business, property, and community.
From garbage collection and bulk waste disposal to sewage and biomedical waste management,

Book a Consultation

Why professional Waste Management matters?

For businesses and communities in the UAE, proper waste management is more than a necessity – it’s part of responsible operations. Whether it’s sewage management, garbage removal services, or hospital waste disposal, our expert team ensures that waste is handled safely, efficiently, and in line with UAE environmental regulations. AED 5,000–50,000 fines per violation under Law No. 18 of 2024, plus the fact that using an unlicensed waste contractor makes the business owner not just the contractor liable.

With our waste management services, you get:

Scheduled garbage collection services tailored to your needs.

Safe collection, transport, and licensed disposal of sewage and fecal sludge from residential, commercial, and industrial sites.

Compliant hospital and biomedical waste disposal.

Bulk waste disposal for commercial and residential projects.

Reliable support available across all seven emirates.

Talk to our Experts

Our Waste Management solutions

We provide a full range of waste disposal services for residential, commercial, and industrial clients:

Book waste management services

Daily and scheduled waste collection for businesses and communities.

Bulk waste disposal

Safe, hygienic handling with advanced disposal methods.

Sewage and fecal sludge management

Efficient removal of construction and large-scale commercial waste.

Hospital & biomedical waste management

Compliant disposal of medical and hazardous materials.

Waste disposal consulting

Tailored solutions to improve efficiency and reduce costs.

Commercial & residential
waste management

From large property developments to individual facilities, our waste management company supports every type of client:

Residential communities

Garbage collection, bulk waste disposal, and sewage management.

Businesses & offices

Customized waste management services to maintain clean, safe premises.

Healthcare facilities

Hospital waste disposal and medical waste management in compliance with UAE regulations.

Industrial clients

Large-scale waste and sludge management tailored to heavy operations.

Fast response & reliable service

Need urgent waste collection or a scheduled plan? Our team delivers flexible waste management solutions across all seven emirates. Whether it’s one-time garbage removal or ongoing waste disposal services, we ensure quick response times and seamless operations without disrupting your business.

Get immediate assistance

Why choose us for waste management?

Certified waste disposal company with UAE regulatory compliance.

Expertise in sewage management, medical waste disposal, and bulk waste collection.

Customized solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial needs.

Trusted by property managers, hospitals, and leading businesses across the UAE.

Regulations and compliance in UAE Waste Management

Waste management in the UAE is strictly regulated, and every business is required to comply with federal and local laws. As a certified waste management company, we ensure that all our services meet or exceed these requirements.

Key regulations we operate under include:

Federal Law No. 12 of 2018 on Integrated Waste Management – the UAE’s main law governing waste collection, transport, treatment, recycling, and disposal.

Cabinet Resolution No. 39 of 2021 – detailed rules for landfill operations, hazardous waste, and safe disposal standards.

Local Order No. 115 of 1997 (Dubai) – regulates the safe handling and disposal of hospital and medical waste.

Abu Dhabi Law No. 21 of 2005 – requires proper systems for storage, treatment, and disposal of all waste categories, enforced by Tadweer.

By working with us, you can be confident that your waste — from garbage collection to biomedical disposal — is handled responsibly, safely, and in full compliance with UAE environmental standards.

Frequently Asked Questions

Still have questions? Our team is here to help 24/7.

Talk to Our Experts

What laws govern waste management in the UAE and what are the consequences of non-compliance?

The major laws governing waste management in the UAE include Federal Law No. 12 of 2018 on Integrated Waste Management, Cabinet Resolution No. 39 of 2021, Local Order No. 115 of 1997 (Dubai), and Abu Dhabi Law No. 21 of 2005. Under Law No. 18 of 2024, every violation of environmental regulations can get you fined between AED 5,000 to AED 50,000.

Do you handle all waste types, or just general garbage collection?

We handle all waste types. Our services include garbage removal, bulk waste disposal, sewage and fecal sludge management, hospital & biomedical waste management, and waste disposal consulting.

How is biomedical and hospital waste handled differently from regular waste?

Yes, biomedical and hospital waste are handled differently from regular waste. Local Order No. 115 of 1997 (Dubai) regulates the safe handling and disposal of hospital and medical waste.

Can you provide waste management for a one-time project rather than an ongoing contract?

ConnectFM can provide you with waste management for a one-time project (construction clearance, office relocation). Our solutions are flexible across all 7 emirates and provide quick response times for any garbage removal or waste disposal needs.

What documentation do we receive to prove compliant waste disposal?

Our company will share a Certification of Destruction with you to prove compliant waste disposal. This certificate shows that the waste has been destroyed according to the regulations and includes all the relevant details.

How do we know waste is actually being disposed of correctly and not illegally dumped?

You can verify if the waste is actually being disposed of correctly and not illegally dumped by using the digital tracking system: Digital Wire Transfer Notes (WTN). WTN is managed in real-time on the Montaji platform, the digital platform by Dubai Municipality.

Still have questions? Our team is here to help 24/7.
